verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a built-in Agent that creates, edits and enhances content across Guides, API References and Custom Pages. It is reachable from an AI chat panel for drafting and research, and inline, where users type plain-language instructions on selected text and the Agent applies the edits. Related built-in AI features include the AI Linter, Docs Audit and the GitHub AI Writer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Agent's task delegation, and deeper documentation of multi-step autonomous task scope and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Agent is a powerful documentation assistant that helps you create, edit, and enhance content across Guides, API References, Custom Pages, and more
When you select text, a prompt field appears in the formatting toolbar where you can type plain-language instructions and let the Agent apply the edits.
Draft, edit, and research documentation from the AI chat panel.
